_comment: Model aliases for run.py. Pure infra config -- prompts/roles live in ../prompts/*.txt, not here. If the 'tag' below isn't pulled on this machine, either `ollama pull` it or edit 'tag' to point at whatever model you do have (`ollama list`). 'vision' must be a vision-capable model (`ollama show <tag>` lists capabilities); 'classifier' is the short yes/no call the context-watch hook makes, so keep num_ctx small for latency.
